main_body: A flat dark-green ground patch (gothic ground tiling) with scattered tiny tufts, brown/red/gold speckles and darker blotches, repeating every 16px
top_band: none - terrain ground tile, no standing object
evidence: This is a terrain ground surface patch, not a standing object, so the 3/4 top/front contract does not apply. There is no standing volume, no side faces and no front elevation. The tile is a seamless ground texture, which is acceptable for terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate is a dark olive base with a faint grid-like cell pattern and sparse tufts. Its main ramp has about 3 steps (base, slightly darker blotches, slightly lighter tuft tops), and the contrast between them is very low. The speckles in red, gold and brown are isolated single pixels or pairs, and the same motif repeats identically every 16px, which looks mechanical. Large areas are one flat colour with no grain. Beodeul grass has several greens, clumped tufts and a darker patch, and the paving has per-stone shading, so the candidate is clearly thinner, with low per-tile colour count and little variation.
